findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous function calls - eval/exec/subprocess
 * @description Detection of potentially dangerous function calls
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/dangerous-calls
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Built-in dangerous functions
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
    
    // Subprocess calls
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen"]).getACall() or
    
    // OS command execution
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("exec*").getACall() or
    
    // Unsafe deserialization
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially dangerous operation that could lead to code injection or command execution"
findings.hypothesis: Looking for dangerous function calls like eval, exec, subprocess, pickle.load that could lead to code injection or command execution

message.text: Potentially dangerous operation that could lead to code injection or command execution

/**
 * @name Inspect dangerous call in style.py
 * @description Check what function call is at the location found earlier
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/inspect-call
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "rich/style.py" and
  call.getLocation().getStartLine() = 471
select call, "Function call at this location: " + call.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Inspect the specific dangerous call found in style.py at line 471
